name: CartFlows
couldBuild: Custom checkout templates, order bumps and a one-click upsell step after payment. Mechanically it is a flow of WooCommerce pages you control.
stillMissing: One-click upsells mean charging a saved payment method after the order completes, which each gateway supports differently and some barely support at all. Plus the template library and keeping step templates working against every builder.
requirements: Multi-step flows with checkout, upsell and thank-you pages
Order bumps rendered and priced correctly at checkout
Post-purchase charges against the stored payment method, per gateway
Conversion tracking per step so the funnel can be read
A starting template library across the common page builders

alternatives.desc: Flows and checkout templates; upsells and bumps are the paid part.
